title: Checking in at the Airport
context: Nina 要飞往芝加哥，来到航空公司柜台办理登机。她向工作人员 Cole 出示护照和订票确认，托运一个行李箱并随身带背包，选择靠窗座位，并询问安检位置、登机时间和登机口。

dialogue.speaker: Nina
dialogue.en: Hi. I'd like to check in for the flight to Chicago, please.
dialogue.zh: 你好。我想办理飞往芝加哥的航班登机手续。

dialogue.speaker: Cole
dialogue.en: Of course. May I see your passport and booking confirmation?
dialogue.zh: 当然可以。我可以看一下你的护照和订票确认吗？

dialogue.speaker: Nina
dialogue.en: Sure. Here they are. I'm on the three-forty flight.
dialogue.zh: 好的。都在这里。我订的是三点四十的航班。

dialogue.speaker: Cole
dialogue.en: Thank you. How many bags are you checking today?
dialogue.zh: 谢谢。今天要托运几个行李？

dialogue.speaker: Nina
dialogue.en: Just one suitcase. I'd also like to carry on this backpack.
dialogue.zh: 就一个行李箱。这个背包我想随身携带。

dialogue.speaker: Cole
dialogue.en: That's fine. Would you prefer a window seat or an aisle seat?
dialogue.zh: 没问题。你想要靠窗的座位，还是靠过道的座位？

dialogue.speaker: Nina
dialogue.en: A window seat, please, if one is still available.
dialogue.zh: 请给我靠窗的座位，如果还有的话。

dialogue.speaker: Cole
dialogue.en: I can give you a window seat near the front. Your bag is just under the weight limit.
dialogue.zh: 我可以给你一个靠近前排的靠窗座位。你的行李刚好在重量限制以内。

dialogue.speaker: Nina
dialogue.en: Great. Do I need to go through security right away?
dialogue.zh: 太好了。我需要马上过安检吗？

dialogue.speaker: Cole
dialogue.en: Yes. Security is down the hall to your left. Boarding starts at three o'clock.
dialogue.zh: 是的。安检就在走廊左边。三点开始登机。

dialogue.speaker: Nina
dialogue.en: Okay. Where can I find the gate number?
dialogue.zh: 好的。我在哪里可以看到登机口号码？

dialogue.speaker: Cole
dialogue.en: It's printed on your boarding pass. You're at Gate B fourteen. Have a good flight!
dialogue.zh: 印在你的登机牌上。你在 B 十四号登机口。祝你飞行愉快！

expressions.zh: 办理航班登机手续。在机场柜台说明来意时常用。
expressions.example: I'd like to check in for the flight to Chicago, please.

expressions.zh: 订票确认。办理登机时通常要出示护照和订票确认。
expressions.example: May I see your passport and booking confirmation?

expressions.zh: 托运行李 / 随身携带。说明哪些行李托运、哪些带上飞机时常用。
expressions.example: Just one suitcase. I'd also like to carry on this backpack.

expressions.en: A window seat or an aisle seat
expressions.zh: 靠窗座位还是靠过道座位。选择座位时常用。注意 aisle 读作 /aɪl/。
expressions.example: Would you prefer a window seat or an aisle seat?

expressions.zh: 登机牌。上面有航班、座位和登机口等信息。
expressions.example: It's printed on your boarding pass. You're at Gate B fourteen.

pronunciation: 练习 aisle 的发音：它读作 I'll，/aɪl/，中间的 s 不发音。注意 check in 的节奏：CHECK in，boarding pass 的重音在前：BOAR-ding pass，以及 confirmation 的重音在第三音节：con-fir-MA-tion。

practice.title: Part 1 · Air travel
practice.prompt: Do you like traveling by plane? Why or why not?
practice.answer: I quite like traveling by plane because it is fast, and I can get to another city in a few hours. I don't like the long lines at security, but a window seat makes the flight more enjoyable.

practice.title: Part 2 · A time you were at an airport
practice.prompt: Describe a time you were at an airport. Say where you were going, what you did at check-in, and how you felt.
practice.answer: Last summer I went to the airport to fly to Chicago. At check-in I showed my passport, checked one suitcase, and asked for a window seat. The agent gave me a boarding pass for Gate B fourteen, and I went through security early. I felt a little nervous, but everything went smoothly. 这是入门短答，请补充个人经历并扩展到接近两分钟。

practice.title: Part 3 · Travel and airports
practice.prompt: Why do some people prefer to check in online instead of at the airport counter?
practice.answer: Online check-in can save time, especially when the airport is busy. People can choose a seat earlier and go straight to the bag drop or security. Some travelers still use the counter if they have questions, extra bags, or a problem with their booking.

practice.title: 跟读与口头练习
practice.prompt: 先听完整对话，再逐句跟读。最后练习说明你要去哪里、托运什么行李、想坐什么座位，以及如何找到登机口。
practice.answer: 用 3–4 句说明你会怎么在机场办理登机：目的地、护照和订票确认、行李和座位，以及登机牌上的登机口。
